input.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees and confirm no payment on termination for HDI's default
input.comment: [Playbook] We are content with the 90 days' notice construct, but the Termination Payment (half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales over $800,000) is an uncapped exit penalty that far exceeds the 30% revenue share we actually pay. We have capped it at three months' fees, our fallback position, and confirmed no payment is owed where we terminate for HDI's default or under Section 1.6.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement for convenience pursuant to Section 4.1, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate fees payable by the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 in respect of the three (3) calendar months preceding the Termination Date. No Termination Payment shall be due in respect of any termination by the Company as a result of HDI's breach or pursuant to Section 1.6.
